label: copy phase, 3rd output (recall_idx 2) in short sequences (L=3-4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase; never on original tokens or the <DEL> step, and never at recall_idx 0. Activation concentrates at the end of the copy: 89% of mass falls on the last two outputs (to_go <= 1), but that predicate has only 5% precision. The strongest locus is the output of original token 2 (recall_idx 2) in short sequences: the L=3 final step (84% precision, the largest activations, top examples like u 3 k <DEL> u [3]) and the L=4 second-to-last step (20% precision). A secondary locus is the last outputs of L=9 sequences (about 14% of mass, 10% precision). Within these positions, which steps fire depends on token identity in a way I could not capture (prev_tok b has 7x lift, but no simple token rule works). Magnitude is highest for L=3 at t=5. Predicate captures 55% of dev mass at 30% precision.
